english: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!\pIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!\pI've opened the locked door of\nthe SKY PILLAR.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!

WALLACE: Hmm…\nThe situation is getting worse…

even here…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pRAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.\pI'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
